blocks.text: Mechanical wooden kits, automata, magic tricks and puzzle boxes

blocks.content:
Hello, I am Shasa Bolton, the designer behind Contraption Cart. I am a mechanical engineer with a passion for mechanisms and objects of curiosity and wonder. I love to design, build and share my ideas so that others can build them too. On my shop page you will find mechanical wooden automata, puzzle boxes, magic tricks and DIY kits designed to be built, explored, and enjoyed.

Each contraption combines engineering, creativity, and hands-on play. Available as laser-cut file downloads or fully assembled pieces, these creations suit adults, hobbyists, and kids working with guidance.

blocks.caption: Turning simple parts into fascinating moving machines.

blocks.text: Browse the shop for magic tricks, puzzle boxes, automata, and more.
